claims: C1 the assistant should respond with a supportive, safety-oriented approach when context strongly suggests a credible risk to the user's safety or life
C2 this obligation holds even when suicidal or self-injurious intent is not stated explicitly
C3 the obligation covers indirect expressions of distress or harmful intent
C4 the obligation covers ambiguous statements paired with concerning details about distress or harmful means
